action: ADMR beneficiaries should be alert to phishing and fraud attempts using their details and report suspicious messages. No action needed for others; for awareness.
date_note: Date the article was published; it says the attack hit the national network between 16 and 24 October.
exec: A home-care charity network had data extracted, exposing vulnerable clients to phishing. Care providers hold sensitive personal data.
plain: A French home-care network was hit by a cyberattack and data was taken. 1,007 people helped by the Tarn branch are affected and may get phishing messages.

key_findings: Per the national ADMR network, data was extracted, with possible risks of fraud and phishing attempts.
The attack hit the national network between 16 and 24 October.

summary: Le Journal d'Ici reports that the ADMR home-care association in Tarn was affected by a cyberattack that hit the national ADMR network between 16 and 24 October. According to the national network, data was extracted, with possible phishing and fraud risks. The paper says 1 007 beneficiaries in Tarn are concerned. Most of the article was behind a paywall.
title: ADMR home-care network cyberattack affects 1,007 beneficiaries in Tarn

validation.note: Only the readable part of Le Journal d'Ici was read; the rest was paywalled and no ADMR statement was found.

review.note: Compared title, 16-24 Oct window, 1 007 beneficiaries, data extracted and national network attribution against the readable teaser of Le Journal d'Ici; paywall disclosed, single_source
